text: During a July 2020 lockdown in London, six friends meet on their weekly Zoom call for [a virtual séance led by a medium|trigger|calling on unseen powers], who warns them not to disrespect the spirits. Bored, Jemma [invents a school friend who hanged himself|rules|break the rule and pay], and when the medium's connection drops, a chair is dragged across a room. Soon the friends glimpse [the legs of a hanging corpse|images|corpses and body parts] in an attic and in a photograph, as [a demon finds its way into their homes|wants|a way into life] one screen at a time.
